# GitHub automation guidance

The [root guidance](../AGENTS.md) applies. Follow the [shared automation guide](https://github.com/Strukturpiloten/boxferry/blob/main/docs/automation.md) and [website development guide](../docs/development.md) for trusted-base bindings, change-aware feedback, and the complete gate. Keep the manifest, workflows, and preset on one reviewed immutable revision. Preserve exact documentation-source locks and the [deployment runbook](../docs/deployment.md)'s historical toolchain exception, artifact retention, and rollback. Deployment requires explicit operator action and any configured environment approval.
